#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    std::regex pattern(R"((.)\1*)");
    std::smatch match;
    std::string::const_iterator searchStart(s.cbegin());
    int result = 0;
    while (std::regex_search(searchStart, s.cend(), match, pattern)) {
        if ((match.str().length() & 1) == 0) {
            result++;
        }
        searchStart = match.suffix().first;
    }
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
